articles.title: Carbon Frames Don't Win Races: Why AI Doesn't Replace Infrastructure
articles.summary: AI can improve the customer experience, but it cannot fix broken financial infrastructure. In fintech, the real competitive advantage lies in the rails underneath: fast settlement, reliable payments, clean data, strong compliance, and systems built to handle real-world volume. As AI becomes table stakes, infrastructure is what will separate the winners from the companies with very expensive chat bubbles.Read All

articles.title: Google launches Gemini for legal work to automate contracts and research
articles.summary: With Gemini Enterprise for Legal, Google launches an AI solution for the legal industry that connects to systems like iManage, DocuSign, and Everlaw through MCP connectors. Partners like Deloitte sell ready-made AI agents for tasks like contract review. Anthropic already offers similar solutions. All providers use the same models as in their other products. articles.title: Nvidia Must Prove It Can Be Tomorrow's AI Platform
articles.summary: PSP Growth Managing Director Momei Qu says Nvidia's earnings will be a key test for the AI trade, with expectations so high that simply beating estimates may not be enough for investors. As the chipmaker looks beyond its dominant data center business, Qu says, "They have to tell the investor world that they will continue to be the AI platform of tomorrow." (Source: Bloomberg)
